issues.claim: Fix step 2: "register a clean alternative (for example hometechremodelingnj.com) with auto-renew on"
issues.problem: The example domain is not available: Verisign RDAP shows hometechremodelingnj.com registered 2026-10-23 (expires 2027-10-23) via Cloudflare, Inc. and it does not resolve. The same day also saw the hyphenated variant registered, so this name family looks squatted. This is advice, not an assertion of availability, and the business-facing audit_md only says "register a clean alternative", so it does not falsify the check, but an owner following the step list would hit a taken domain.
issues.fix: Replace the example with an instruction to check availability of a fresh name (e.g. "choose a new .com such as hometechremodelingnj.com only if RDAP shows it unregistered"), or drop the named example.

issues.claim: audit_md: "someone who tries the company name plus '.com' gets a server error"
issues.problem: What the visitor actually gets is an Akamai 'Access Denied' page (a 403 permission error, which audit_md itself names correctly two lines earlier), not a server-side fault. Slightly loose plain-English wording rather than a false statement, since the page really is an error page.
issues.fix: Say "gets an 'Access Denied' error page" for consistency with the first bullet.
